citizens namely pedestrians bike riders people on electric scooters people on mobile scooters that aren't electric any essentially multi-modal type of transport this community has unfortunately a severe lack of infrastructure which provides safe passage for those individuals whether it's as simple as sidewalks bump outs chicanes any of the other more recently adapted models around the country and i'm here to again ask council to give consideration to that study after study shows that improving the safety of transportation for those individuals improves the safety for everybody a 13-year study found that in adding infrastructure for bike lanes which are physically separated from driving lanes there's a 44 percent reduction in traffic fatalities and a 50 percent reduction in crashes
